featured_reviews.name: saumil shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Apsara icecream is a renowned icecream parlour  brand of Mumbai since around 50 yrs. I believe as of today they have about 30 outlets in Mumbai itself.They also have outlets spread across other cities of India.I visited their Malabar hill outlet  yesterday night which is their iconic outlet

They serve variety of icecreams in cups(small,medium.large)  as well as cones.

Icecreams made here are with natural flavours and not artificial flavours.These icecreams are handchurned icecreams.

Staff service is reasonably good at Malabar hill outlet but i personally have seen better staff service at other parlours.Definite scope of improvement on staff service front.Apart from icecreams they also have sorbets & shakes.

Coming to variety of icecreams i tried here

Guava glory (small cup)- Star icecream of Apsara for me .Try it with red chilli powder(peru chaat masala) on top of icecream .Highly recommended

Malai kulfi stick -This about taking you back to sweet childhood memories.

Its a delicious sweet dessert served on stick .You will relish it if you like malai flavour.They also have options in pistachio and kesar pista.

Beligan bites (cone) -This i tried in waffle cone.This is all about enjoying Beligan chocolate with chips

Scrumptious sitafal(small cup) -A perfect combination of icecream and exotic creamy fruit.This is dessert goodness at next level.I personally loved it

Pan pasand(cone) - Before visiting this place.I had heard a lot of good things about their pan pasand icecream.Try this and you will thank me for recommending it

Tamarind twist(sorbet) - Imli in form of dessert.This is innovation and experimentation at its best.This sorbet has sharp flavour of tangy tamarind.

My overall experience was reasonably good at Apsara icecreams.A good option for late night icecream cravings.

I genuinely hope to see them coming up with premium range of desserts in coming times.

I didnt try their Thandai and couple of other shakes.Will definitely try it the next time i visit them

Overall - Definitely worth your  money

Check it out

featured_reviews.name: dindindubai
featured_reviews.review_text:
County Of Origin

Always saw it from the window of my car while taking a stroll on the streets of Bandra, never knew the parent version of this place was just there in my neighbourhood at Napensea Road.
Desserts being my favourite, I was glad to visit the place. Very amazed to see how such a piece of art that this place is has been hidden in the heart of south mumbai since so long.
Firstly the vibe of the place is so breathtaking, soothing, calming, a soul will not be embarrassed to make this place, its second home. Amazing vibes coming from each corner of the house, dim lights and the aroma of sweetness in the air of the house was a perfect place to spend my evening.
Country Of Origin has a stylish vintage touch to it, along with the amazing variety and originality of the desserts makes it a perfect blend that I look for in a place.
To my surprise, this place is everything I want.
Starting with Schwarzwälder Kirschtorte (yes I learned it right) is the Traditional Black Forest Cake with Cherry Brandy all the way from Germany! Hear some bells ringing when I say that? Missing that Childhood Black Forest Cake you had while you were invited for a birthday party in your kindergartens good old days? This Black Forest Cake is different. Mr Kiran has taken the pains to travel all the way to Germany to get you the original Black Forest Cake also known as "Schwarzwälder Kirschtorte".
Next up for us was the Red Velvet. Very well made, not too sweet, with the goodness of white cream cheese. I loved the way it was subtle to taste. Usually Red Velvet can be too sweet to eat up the whole block, but this one was so nicely made that I couldn't stop eating, am surely visiting the place again for this piece.
The very rich and exotic piece at Country Of Origin, were the Mascarpone Crème Éclair and Dark Chocolate & Whisky Éclair. Éclair's have always been my favourite piece of dessert. Mascarpone Crème Éclair was my favourite out of the two since it reminded me a softer and a better version of Crème rolls. Dark Chocolate & Whisky Éclair is a really good choice for people loving Dark Chocolate, whisky making it even better.
Next on the plates were our mini friends in shots, just the way I like it!
Caramel & Butter Scotch Cheese Cake, I've always been a fan of Caramel Cheese Cake, when mixed with Butter Scotch was a perfect combination of rich creamy caramel with a nutty touch to your tongue, my personal favourite from the shots not forgetting perfectly made layers of Hazelnut Caramel, the bliss of Caramel in between the goodness of Hazelnut.
Do visit the place for more flavours like Lemon Cheese Cake and Red Velvet Shots!
For next on the menu is their very famous Country Of Origin Espresso Mug: It's not just any mug, A mug with Molten Chocolate Cake oozing the yummiest hot chocolate you've ever had. Getting hot in here? You also get to keep the mug as a souvenir for free.
COO offers variety of Brownies, Muffins and Dessert Jars.
Double Chocolate Brownie
Intense Chocolate Brownie
Hazelnut Crème Brownie &
Espresso Brownie being my favourites ❤️
COO is actually very thoughtful for those loving em Gluten Free!!
Heard right! COO has Gluten Free Brownies and Gluten Free Tea Cake and Cookies.
Talking about the Muffins, tasted the Soft Centred Belgian Chocolate Muffin and the White Chocolate & Hazelnut Muffin. Muffins were really soft and filled with goodness of chocolate, especially the White Chocolate with Hazelnut essence blending righteously with White Chocolate tasted rich. Have it Soft & Warm.
Last but not the least I was in love with their Granola Bars they had to offer. Very Healthy And Snackable.
COO surely has something for everyone.
Do visit the place. It's worth the visit.
Go COO!
